title_zh: 约定更正人体展台的两张标签

scenario.label_zh: 约定更正人体展台的两张标签
scenario.goal_zh: 依据课本区分头骨模型与组织图片，并约定更正两张展台标签

context_zh: 学生和教师为课堂人体展台核对模型及图片的名称。
author: author-phase09-b

sentences.speaker: Lina
sentences.text: I've labelled this whole model 'brain'. Is that right?

sentences.speaker: Mr Cole
sentences.text: Look at the picture in your textbook. The hard outer part is the skull; the brain would sit inside it.

sentences.speaker: Lina
sentences.text: So the model shows the skull, not the brain. And I've labelled this photograph 'a whole muscle'. Is that right?

sentences.speaker: Mr Cole
sentences.text: Its caption says 'muscle tissue'. It's a close-up photograph, not a picture of a whole muscle.

sentences.speaker: Lina
sentences.text: I'll change the model label to 'skull' and copy the photograph's caption exactly.

sentences.speaker: Mr Cole
sentences.text: Good. Add the textbook page number underneath so visitors can find the explanation.

targets.sense_zh: 组织（构成生物身体的细胞群）
